Hvor mange universiteter er der i Danmar: How many universities are there in Denmark, and how long do a bachelor's and a master's degree take?
Otte universiteter. Bachelor ca. tre år,: Eight universities. Bachelor's about three years, master's (kandidat) about two years.
Statens Uddannelsesstøtte – økonomisk st: Statens Uddannelsesstøtte (the State Education Grant) – financial support from the state to students.
En videregående uddannelse på deltid på: A part-time higher education at bachelor level, typically 2–3 years. You pay for it yourself.
Arbejdsmarkedsuddannelser – korte kurser: Labour market training (arbejdsmarkedsuddannelser) – short courses, mainly for skilled and unskilled workers.
Hvad er FVU, og hvor tager man det?: What is FVU, and where do you take it?
Kurser for voksne med problemer med at s: Courses for adults who have problems with spelling, reading or maths. Taken at VUC. Normally from age 25.
Dyslexia teaching for adults at VUC. Normally from age 25.
Almen voksenuddannelse på VUC – enkeltfa: General adult education at VUC – single subjects at primary/lower secondary level. The highest level is D. Normally from age 25.
Hvem er ansvarlig for dagtilbud i Danmar: Who is responsible for day care in Denmark?
Har alle børn ret til en plads i et dagt: Do all children have the right to a place in day care?
Kommunen betaler en del, forældrene beta: The municipality pays part, the parents pay the rest. With a low income or as a single parent you can apply for a subsidy.
Hvorfor ville man siden 1960'erne have b: Why, since the 1960s, did people want children looked after outside the home?
For at få kvinderne ud på arbejdsmarkede: To get women into the labour market.
Hvilken aldersgruppe er vuggestue for?: Which age group is a nursery (vuggestue) for?
Børn fra cirka seks måneder op til cirka: Children from about six months up to about three years.
Passes af en dagplejer sammen med to-fir: Children are looked after by a childminder together with two to four other children in the childminder's private home (approx. 6 months – 3 years).
Hvilken aldersgruppe er børnehave for?: Which age group is a kindergarten (børnehave) for?
Children from about three up to six years.
SkoleFritidsOrdning – passer børn i folk: School after-school scheme (SkoleFritidsOrdning) – looks after folkeskole children before and after school hours.
Older children and young people, after school.
Hvem vælger forældrebestyrelsen, og hvad: Who elects the parents' board, and what does it have influence on?
Forældrene vælger repræsentanter. Bestyr: The parents elect representatives. The board has influence on the institution's finances and activities.
Må man ryge i dagplejehjemmet?: May you smoke in a childminder's home?
Ikke i de dele, hvor børnene opholder si: Not in the parts where the children stay.
Hvem bestemmer de fleste regler om ansæt: Who decides most rules about employment conditions in Denmark?
Arbejdsmarkedets parter – fagforeningern: The labour market parties – the trade unions and the employers' organisations (not the Folketing). The system goes back to 1899.
En aftale mellem fagforeninger og arbejd: An agreement between trade unions and employers' organisations about pay, working hours, etc. Usually lasts two or three years.
Ingen strejker eller lockout, så længe o: No strikes or lockouts as long as the collective agreement applies.
Lønmodtagere standser arbejdet, indtil d: Employees stop working until a collective agreement has been reached.
Arbejdsgiveren forbyder fagforeningsmedl: The employer bars union members from coming to work until a collective agreement has been reached.
Hvilke instanser afgør overtrædelser af: Which bodies decide on breaches of collective agreements?
Arbejdsretten og faglige voldgiftsretter: The Labour Court (Arbejdsretten) and industrial arbitration tribunals (outside the ordinary courts).
Hvad kaldes det system, hvor parterne og: What is the system called where the labour market parties, not the Folketing, decide labour market conditions?
Let for arbejdsgivere at ansætte og fyre: Easy for employers to hire and fire (flexibility) – in return employees are financially secured through unemployment benefits (security).
Er der en lovbestemt mindsteløn i Danmar: Is there a statutory minimum wage in Denmark?
Nej. Det afhænger af de kollektive overe: No. It depends on the collective agreements.
Hvad er bestemt ved lov (og ikke overens: What is set by law (and not by collective agreement) regarding holidays?
Five weeks' holiday is set by law.
Hvilken strejke stoppede Folketinget i 2: Which strike did the Folketing stop in 2021?
Sygeplejerskernes strejke (efter over to: The nurses' strike (after more than two months) – the Folketing imposed the agreement by law.
Hvilke grupper er ofte ikke dækket af ov: Which groups are often not covered by collective agreements?
Mange højtuddannede i det private (ingen: Many highly educated people in the private sector (engineers, economists, lawyers), the restaurant industry and traditionally agriculture.
Hvor stor en andel af lønmodtagerne er m: What share of employees are members of a trade union today?
Omkring to ud af tre (68 procent). I 199: About two out of three (68 percent). In 1990 it was about five out of six.
Er det et krav at være medlem af en fagf: Is it a requirement to be a member of a trade union?
Nej, det er frivilligt. Ingen må tvinge: No, it is voluntary. No one may force you to be a member.
Må en arbejdsgiver fyre en person, fordi: May an employer fire a person because they join or leave a trade union?
Hvilke faggrupper repræsenterer HK?: Which occupational groups does HK represent?
Handel og kontor: butiksansatte, laboran: Trade and office: shop staff, laboratory technicians, secretaries, receptionists, dental/clinic assistants.
Hvilke faggrupper repræsenterer FOA?: Which occupational groups does FOA represent?
Hjemmepleje, SOSU-assistenter, brandmænd: Home care, social and healthcare assistants (SOSU), firefighters, canteen staff.
Industri, transport og byggeri: svejsere: Industry, transport and construction: welders, drivers, bricklayers, carpenters, cleaners and other unskilled workers.
Hvem vælger tillidsrepræsentanten, og hv: Who elects the shop steward, and how many employees must there typically be?
Fagforeningens medlemmer på arbejdsplads: The union members at the workplace elect them – typically at workplaces with more than ten employees. The employer does not attend the meeting.
Hvad er tillidsrepræsentantens opgave?: What is the shop steward's job?
At repræsentere de ansatte over for lede: To represent the employees towards management (e.g. in pay negotiations) and give advice. Has special protection against dismissal.
Hvad kaldes fagforeningens møder på arbe: What are the union's meetings at the workplace called?
Hvad er arbejdsmiljørepræsentantens opga: What is the work environment representative's job?
At holde øje med det fysiske og psykiske: To keep an eye on the physical and psychological work environment (e.g. safety equipment, support, bullying, stress).
Hvem skal have et ansættelsesbevis, og h: Who must get an employment contract (ansættelsesbevis), and when?
Alle der arbejder mere end tre timer om: Everyone who works more than three hours a week for more than four weeks – no later than one month after starting.
Hvad må en arbejdsgiver ikke spørge om v: What may an employer not ask about in a job interview?
Helbred (uden betydning for jobbet), syg: Health (unrelated to the job), sick days in previous jobs, pregnancy/plans for children and religion.
Hvad er den mest almindelige arbejdstid: What is the most common working time per week?
Kan arbejdsgiveren forlange, at man går: Can the employer demand that you go part-time?
Nej. Man kan bede om nedsat tid, men arb: No. You can ask for reduced hours, but the employer decides whether you get it.
Hvor mange feriedage optjener man pr. må: How many holiday days do you earn per month, and how many weeks of holiday do you get per year?
Cirka to feriedage pr. måned – fem ugers: About two holiday days per month – five weeks of paid holiday after a full year. Some have a sixth week.
Hvornår har man normalt ret til tre uger: When do you normally have the right to three consecutive weeks of holiday?
Et udvalg på større arbejdspladser, hvor: A committee at larger workplaces where management and the employees' shop stewards discuss conditions.
Hvad kræver reglerne om fyring af arbejd: What do the rules on dismissal require of the employer in most cases?
En saglig og reel grund (fx uegnethed, s: A fair and genuine reason (e.g. unsuitability, cooperation problems or cutbacks).
Hvad må en arbejdsgiver ikke fyre en ans: For what reasons may an employer not dismiss an employee?
Køn, race, hudfarve, religion, politiske: Gender, race, skin colour, religion, political views, sexual orientation, age, disability, national/social/ethnic origin, pregnancy or maternity leave.
En arbejdsløshedskasse – en frivillig fo: An unemployment insurance fund – a voluntary insurance (members' association) that pays unemployment benefits (dagpenge). Supported by the state.
Hvad skal man gøre for at få dagpenge?: What must you do to get unemployment benefits?
Have arbejdet forud, stå til rådighed fo: Have worked beforehand, be available for the labour market, actively look for work, accept offered work and take part in meetings and activities.
Hvad hedder den digitale jobplan for led: What is the digital job plan for the unemployed called?
Hvornår overtager kommunen ansvaret for: When does the municipality take over responsibility for an unemployed a-kasse member?
Hvad kan man få, hvis man mister sit arb: What can you get if you lose your job and are not a member of an a-kasse?
Kontanthjælp fra kommunen (afhænger af e: Social assistance (kontanthjælp) from the municipality (depends on your own and your spouse's income and assets). Normally lower than unemployment benefits.
Hvor registrerer man sig som selvstændig: Where do you register as self-employed?
Hos Erhvervsstyrelsen (via dens hjemmesi: With the Danish Business Authority (Erhvervsstyrelsen), via its website.
Hvad har en selvstændig pligt til?: What duty does a self-employed person have?
At føre regnskab og opgive virksomhedens: To keep accounts and report the business's profit or loss to SKAT (the tax authority).
Hvor mange fuldtidslandmænd er der omtre: Roughly how many full-time farmers are there in Denmark today?
Hvor stor en del af landbrugsarealet dri: What share of farmland is farmed organically?
Hvad er et andelsselskab, og hvor mange: What is a cooperative (andelsselskab), and how many votes does each farmer have?
Et selskab ejet af landmændene selv. Hve: A company owned by the farmers themselves. Each farmer has one vote, no matter how much he supplies.
Hvad hedder de to store andelsselskaber: What are the two big cooperatives for dairies and slaughterhouses called?
Hvilke lande kommer Arlas ejere fra?: Which countries do Arla's owners come from?
Danmark, Sverige, Tyskland, Holland, Bel: Denmark, Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg and the UK (almost 10,000 farmers).
Hvilken virksomhed er kendt for byggeklo: Which company is known for building bricks?
Hvilken dansk medicinalvirksomhed fremst: Which Danish pharmaceutical company produces insulin, among other things?
Hvor stor en del af verdens høreapparate: What share of the world's hearing aids are made in Denmark?
Hvad er verdens største vindmølleproduce: What is the world's largest wind turbine manufacturer (2024), and where is it based?
Hvilken mølle fra 1957 inspirerede den m: Which wind turbine from 1957 inspired the modern wind turbine industry?
The Gedser turbine (and the Tvind turbine 1975–78).
Hvad producerer Rockwool, Grundfos, Danf: What do Rockwool, Grundfos, Danfoss and Velux produce?
Rockwool = isolering; Grundfos = pumper;: Rockwool = insulation; Grundfos = pumps; Danfoss = thermostats; Velux = windows.
Fra hvilket land importerer Danmark mest: Which country does Denmark import most from, and which country does it export most to?
Importerer mest fra Tyskland; eksportere: Imports most from Germany; exports most to the USA.
Hvem er Danmarks to største handelspartn: Who are Denmark's two biggest trading partners in 2025?
USA (14,1 %) og Tyskland (12,7 %). Deref: The USA (14.1%) and Germany (12.7%). Then Sweden, the Netherlands, the UK, China, Norway.
Et dansk rederi – et af verdens to størs: A Danish shipping company – one of the world's two biggest container shipping lines.
Hvornår er det planen, at dansk olieprod: When is Danish oil production planned to have stopped completely?
Dansk servicevirksomhed (rengøring, ejen: A Danish service company (cleaning, property services, security) with about half a million employees worldwide.
Hvad er princippet i det danske velfærds: What is the principle of the Danish welfare society?
Alle der kan, bidrager (arbejder og beta: Everyone who can contributes (works and pays tax), and everyone in need can get help from the public sector.
Borgerne via skatter, moms, afgifter – s: Citizens through taxes, VAT and duties – plus corporate taxes, property taxes and returns on pension savings.
Hvad er princippet for skat i Danmark?: What is the principle of taxation in Denmark?
Jo mere man tjener, jo større del af løn: The more you earn, the larger the share of your pay you pay in tax.
Hvor stor er momsen i Danmark?: How high is VAT (moms) in Denmark?
Børne- og ungeydelse til forældre med bø: Child and youth benefit paid to parents of children under 18. High earners get less or nothing.
Hvad kaldes økonomisk hjælp ved længere: What is financial help during longer illness called?
Man arbejder og tjener en del selv og få: You work and earn part of your income yourself and get the rest as a public benefit – for people with reduced working capacity.
Hvem kan få førtidspension?: Who can get early retirement pension (førtidspension)?
Personer med en varig og væsentligt neds: People with a permanent and substantially reduced ability to work.
Fra hvilken alder kan man få folkepensio: From what age can you get the state pension (folkepension) in 2026?
Fra 67 år (aldersgrænsen hæves gradvist): From 67 (the age limit is gradually being raised).
Hvad er kravet til bopæl for folkepensio: What is the residence requirement for the state pension and early retirement pension?
Dansk statsborger (hovedregel), fast bop: Danish citizenship (as a main rule), permanent residence in Denmark and at least three years' residence after turning 15.
Hvor længe skal man have boet i Danmark: How long must you have lived in Denmark to get the full state pension?
40 år. Har man boet her kortere tid, får: 40 years. If you have lived here for a shorter time, you get a pension in proportion to the number of years.
Hvad er arbejdsmarkedspension?: What is a labour market pension (arbejdsmarkedspension)?
Pension der indbetales via ens arbejde –: A pension paid in through your job – on top of the state pension.
Støtte til huslejen for lejere med lav i: Help with rent for tenants with low income. Pensioners with low income can often get higher housing benefit.
Hvad kaldes sundhedskortet i daglig tale: What is the health insurance card commonly called?
\"Det gule kort\". Alle der er tilmeldt: "The yellow card" (det gule kort). Everyone registered in the CPR gets one.
Hvad betyder sikringsgruppe 1?: What does health insurance group 1 (sikringsgruppe 1) mean?
Man er tilmeldt en bestemt praktiserende: You are registered with a specific GP and need a referral to a specialist (except ear and eye doctors) for free treatment.
Hvad koster det at låne bøger på bibliot: What does it cost to borrow books at the library?
Hvilke to broer koster penge at køre ove: Which two bridges cost money to drive across?
The Øresund Bridge and the Great Belt Bridge (Storebæltsbroen).
Hvad er afgifter, og hvorfor har man dem: What are duties (afgifter), and why do we have them?
Særlige skatter på fx biler, benzin, alk: Special taxes on e.g. cars, petrol, alcohol, cigarettes, batteries, disposable tableware and carrier bags – justified by revenue, environment and health.
Hvor gammel skal man mindst være for at: What is the minimum age for getting married?
Må man være gift med flere personer på é: May you be married to several people at once?
No – only one at a time.
Må man tvinge nogen til at blive gift?: May you force someone to get married?
No. Both parties must want the marriage.
Kan par af samme køn blive gift og adopt: Can same-sex couples marry and adopt children?
Yes, on an equal footing with other couples.
På rådhuset, i folkekirken eller i anerk: At the town hall, in the Church of Denmark or in recognised religious communities (the priest/leader must be authorised for the wedding to be valid).
At forældrene sammen tager vigtige beslu: That the parents together make important decisions about the child (name, upbringing, school, religion, childcare).
Hvordan får ugifte forældre fælles foræl: How do unmarried parents get joint custody?
Ved i forbindelse med fødslen at afgive: By making a declaration in connection with the birth that they will share the care and responsibility.
Hvor stor en andel af ægteskaber ender m: What share of marriages end in divorce?
En slags prøvetid, hvor man stadig er gi: A kind of trial period where you are still married but normally live apart.
Hvornår har man ret til skilsmisse efter: When are you entitled to a divorce after separation?
Efter et halvt års separation. Er man en: After six months of separation. If you agree, you can divorce straight away.
Hvem hjælper forældre, der ikke kan bliv: Who helps parents who cannot agree about the children after a divorce?
